others.route: Permiso especial de permanencia (actividades comerciales o de espectáculos públicos)

note: Honduras: among the thirteen special stay permits of up to five years granted by the National Migration Institute is one for foreigners in commercial activities or public spectacles; a visitor's stay is up to 90 days (Spain's Embassy in Tegucigalpa, summarising the Honduran rules; the Institute's own requirements weren't retrieved). No days of performing without it are named.

sources.title: Embajada de España en Honduras, Establecerse en Honduras
sources.said: Hay trece tipos de permisos especiales de permanencia por un máximo de cinco años: ... Extranjeros en actividades comerciales o de espectáculos públicos;
